provenance.gatheredBy: load-sport-data, the 2026 League Championship Series as played: in the ALCS the Tampa Bay Rays beat the Cleveland Guardians in six (12-19 October, Game 4 postponed a day), in the NLCS the Milwaukee Brewers swept the Los Angeles Dodgers (11-15 October). Both series are one event; game N holds both series' Game N, so Games 5 and 6 are the ALCS's alone. The field is the four clubs' position players on their League Championship Series active rosters, from the MLB Stats API; ranking is the player's 2026 regular-season Box Score total (total bases + runs + RBI + walks + stolen bases), all clubs' for a player traded during the season. Each game's box score (total bases, runs, RBI, walks, stolen bases) is from the MLB Stats API, cross-checked player by player against ESPN's box scores on runs, hits, RBI, home runs and walks, and on each side's total bases and stolen bases, which agree in every game. A player with no plate appearance in a game has no line; one who batted and recorded none of the five has an empty line.
